title: Large Language Models for Fuzz Testing in Microservices: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: arXiv:2609.04219v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Microservice systems (MSS) increasingly rely on heterogeneous APIs whose combinatorial input space and stateful dependencies challenge traditional fuzz testing. Meanwhile, Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently been introduced to enhance fuzzing with semantic reasoning over specifications, inputs, and runtime feedback. This paper presents a systematic literature review (SLR) of LLM-assisted fuzz testing for microservices to synthesise how LLMs are applied, evaluated, and what challenges remain. Following established SLR guidelines, we analyze 20 primary studies published between 2024 and 2026. Results show LLMs are mainly used as semantic input generators in black-box fuzzing, with a growing shift towards agent-based and retrieval-augmented architectures, improving valid input generation and modestly increasing coverage and vulnerability detection. translated_title: 微服务中基于大语言模型的模糊测试：一项系统性文献综述
translated_abstract: 微服务系统（MSS）日益依赖异构API，其组合式的输入空间和有状态依赖性对传统模糊测试提出了挑战。与此同时，大语言模型（LLM）近年来被引入，通过对规范、输入和运行时反馈进行语义推理来增强模糊测试。本文对面向微服务的LLM辅助模糊测试进行了系统性文献综述（SLR），以综合分析LLM的应用方式、评估方法以及仍存在的挑战。遵循既定的SLR指南，我们分析了2024年至2026年间发表的20项主要研究。结果表明，LLM主要在黑盒模糊测试中用作语义输入生成器，并正逐渐向基于智能体和检索增强的架构转变，改善了有效输入的生成，并适度提升了测试覆盖率与漏洞检测能力。然而，相关评估方式仍较为分散，基准标准化程度有限，可扩展性（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该系统性文献综述分析了20项研究，发现大语言模型主要作为微服务黑盒模糊测试中的语义输入生成器，并正向基于智能体和检索增强的架构演进，有效提升了输入生成质量与漏洞检测能力，但评估基准的标准化仍显不足。
en_tdlr: This systematic literature review of 20 primary studies shows that LLMs mainly serve as semantic input generators in black-box fuzzing for microservices, with a growing shift toward agent-based and retrieval-augmented architectures that improve valid input generation and modestly increase coverage and vulnerability detection, though benchmark standardization remains limited.
